title: Cantaloupe De Charentais Melon - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Heavy Cropping Sweet
description:
Grow Your Own Exquisite French Melons at Home!


KEY FEATURES
• Exquisite sweet and aromatic orange flesh
• Productive vines yield abundant, high-quality fruits
• Heirloom French variety, renowned for gourmet flavour
• Perfect for desserts, breakfasts, and fresh eating
• Mini plug plants offer a strong start for successful growth


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Vegetables — Cucumis melo var. cantalupensis
Colour: Grey-green skin with dark ribs, vibrant orange flesh
Season: Summer (July - September in UK with protection)
Growth Habit: Trailing vine
Flavour: Intensely sweet, aromatic, juicy with musky undertones
Time to Harvest: 80-90 days from planting


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Full sun
Soil: Rich, well-drained, sandy loam
Watering: Consistent and regular, especially during fruiting; avoid waterlogging
Spacing: 90-120 cm between plants, 1.5-2 m between rows
Height: Trailing vines up to 1.5-2.5 m (can be trained vertically)
Spread: 1.5-2.5 m
Hardiness: UK H1b (requires protection/greenhouse in most UK climates)


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant in a warm, sunny location, ideally in a greenhouse or polytunnel in the UK.
• Ensure soil is consistently moist but not waterlogged; water deeply at the base of the plant.
• Feed regularly with a high-potash fertiliser once fruits begin to set.
• Provide support for vines if growing vertically; pinch out side shoots for better fruit development.
• Harvest when the melon detaches easily from the stem and emits a sweet fragrance.


WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants


DISPATCH
Plants are carefully packed and dispatched Monday-Wednesday to avoid weekend delays.
